title: Credit Quality Policy: Nonaccrual Status of Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Policy.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan in active status is placed in nonaccrual when an installment remains not paid in full more than the product's nonaccrual threshold in calendar days after its due date, the due date being day 0. While in nonaccrual, payments are still applied under the payment application rules, late charges stop, and no deferral, release on sale or substitution is available. The loan returns to active status on the day every installment whose due date has passed is paid in full (no past-due installment remains). A deferred loan is not placed in nonaccrual for the deferred installment.

## The threshold on both sides

Hypothetical: a threshold of 90 calendar days and an installment due on day 0 that stays unpaid.

| Day after the due date | Installment still not paid in full | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Day 90 | yes | not yet more than 90 days — remains active |
| Day 91 | yes | more than 90 days — placed in nonaccrual |

## While in nonaccrual

| Servicing matter | In nonaccrual |
|---|---|
| Payments | still applied under the payment application rules |
| Late charges | stop |
| Deferral | not available |
| Release on sale | not available |
| Substitution | not available |

## Return to active status

The loan returns to active status on the day the last past-due installment is paid in full — that is, on the day every installment whose due date has passed is paid in full. Paying only the oldest of two past-due installments leaves the loan in nonaccrual.

## Deferred installment

A loan whose installment was deferred is not placed in nonaccrual on account of that deferred installment.
